def transform(grid):
    # Separator lines are the color occurring as complete rows/columns.
    sep = next(c for c in set(sum(grid, [])) if sum(all(x == c for x in row) for row in grid) > 0)
    # block boundaries at full separator rows/columns
    rb = [-1] + [i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == sep for x in row)] + [len(grid)]
    cb = [-1] + [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[i][j] == sep for i in range(len(grid)))] + [len(grid[0])]
    # Non-separator colors: most frequent is background; odd counts of the other color(s) mark output.
    vals = [x for row in grid for x in row if x != sep]
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(rb,rb[1:]):
        line=[]
        for c,d in zip(cb,cb[1:]):
            cells=[grid[i][j] for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(c+1,d) if grid[i][j] != sep]
            marks=sum(x != bg for x in cells)
            line.append(1 if marks%2 else bg)
        out.append(line)
    return out
PY
